# Ahmad El Lahib – Freelance App & Website Developer (Lebanon)

> Ahmad El Lahib is a senior software developer based in Baabda, Lebanon, with 12+ years of experience (since 2014). He builds native Android apps (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose), Windows desktop apps (C#, .NET, WPF) and fast, mobile-friendly websites for businesses in Beirut and across Lebanon, and uses AI-assisted development and AI features in his work. Languages: Arabic, English, French.

Contact: ahmad@ahmadellahib.dev · WhatsApp +961 71 312 535 · https://ahmadellahib.dev/
Not offered as a freelance service: POS, payment, card or vending-payment apps.

## Services

- [Freelance Android App Developer in Lebanon](https://ahmadellahib.dev/android-app-developer-lebanon/): native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose apps for businesses in Beirut and across Lebanon.
- [Freelance Website Developer in Lebanon](https://ahmadellahib.dev/website-developer-lebanon/): fast, mobile-friendly company websites, landing pages and web apps.
- [Freelance Windows App Developer in Lebanon](https://ahmadellahib.dev/windows-app-developer-lebanon/): C#, .NET and WPF apps for back-office work, dashboards and tools that connect to printers, scanners and serial or USB devices.
